posts.headline: Tyrique14 finally has a ring, but a 14-14 career record and an average finish of 5.5 says #FreeMaxx Champions is one hot streak away from being a one-hit wonder.
posts.detail: Winning it all in 2025 buys you exactly zero credibility for 2026 — this is a .500 franchise with a title, and the league is coming for it.

posts.headline: Put it in Ra has the gaudiest resume in the league — a 20-8 record and back-to-back top-2 finishes — and STILL no championship to show for it.
posts.detail: A 1.5 average finish over two seasons is video-game numbers, but until adambarner111 actually hoists the trophy, this is the best team that hasn't won anything.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh is the most misleadingly named team in Busters Anonymous history — a 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th place finish is the opposite of talented.
posts.detail: With a .286 win percentage in their lone season, this roster hasn't earned the right to talk trash to anybody in this league yet.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World has a championship banner but a losing 13-15 career record — that title looks more like a lucky bounce than a dynasty in the making.
posts.detail: An average finish of 5.5 with a worst finish of 8th means Alxgalvn's crown is sitting on a shaky throne heading into 2026.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh finished dead last in the entire league last year, and nothing about a 5-9 record suggests that's about to change.
posts.detail: An 11th place finish and a .357 win percentage is the definition of a team nobody in Busters Anonymous is losing sleep over.
